_doc: Energy/time constants for optimize.py (roadmap B5). PROVISIONAL 2026-10-25 22:50: built from data collected BEFORE the arm repair + gripper re-cal (18:20) and with the coarse servo-current arm power. Redo after the vision_check_v1 run (A1): refit model.json, re-check arm W with the arm INA260 (B3), u_IR / ETA from the new session (B4). Units: belt rpm = real output rpm (output_rpm_cpr11880). Every number has a source. UPDATE 23:45: A1 (exp_20261025_232408_vision_check_v1, 24/24 OK) confirms the grid for the new gripper (cycle time drift +1.3 % at 20/1.5, +2.9 % at 15/1.5); model refitted on grid + A1. Arm INA260 read NaN for the whole run, so arm W is still the coarse servo-current sum.

P_rest_torque_off_W.source: not measured (B1c skipped: Mega firmware does not answer Q)

P_wait_in_cycle_W.source: energy_blocks 20/1.5: idle 2.2 J over 51 % of 19.1 s

arm.power_method: servo current sum (final; no arm INA260 exists). It misses the servo electronics standby draw, so arm J is a slight underestimate.
arm.ina260_diagnosis: operator 2026-10-26: there is NO arm INA260 (by design). The only INA260 is the conveyor one on SDA 20 / SCL 21. Arm power = servo current sum (STS3215 current register x 6.5 mA/count x bus V): final method.

rest_transition.source: B1b runs + B2 round 1 (base_20261025_190640); B2 stopped after 1 round

T_breakeven_rest_s.why: P_rest (0.30 W) > P_home (0.084 W): resting never saves energy. Even at 0 W rest it would need ~240 s idle and costs 73 s of unavailability.

idle_rule.what: hold home + brake the belt; rest only for parking/shutdown

u_IR_px.source: A1: last u before ARRIVED in the 4 detected cycles (old provisional 247)

detection.effect: optimize.py does not trust the camera (needs >= 9 of the last 10 good cycles); empty feeder falls back to 2 transport timeouts

direction.value: cubes move toward SMALLER u (588 -> ~242 px) while the camera publishes dir = 1
direction.effect: observe/predict velocities are negative; optimize.py uses |velocity|

scene.roi_hazards: two pink tape strips inside the ROI near v~260 (red/purple ranges may see them)
scene.ir_side: left, cubes travel right->left (u shrinks): run vision with --belt-dir -1

colors.notes: orange preset H 9-21 is far from the pink tape (H ~160-175) and the green belt; skin is also orange-ish: keep hands out of the ROI while running

per_cube._doc: Measured per block of exp_20261025_005038_opt_grid_v1 by cal/energy_blocks.py (window = 1st to last cycle end of a block). s_per_cube is block wall time / cubes; J are motor supplies only (belt INA260 + servo current sum), not Pi / Mega / drivers.

safe_default.why: best throughput, J/cube within 3 % of the minimum; arm 2.0 caused transport timeouts

a1_check.arm_ina260: n/a: no arm INA260 on this robot (arm_current/arm_voltage fields are always NaN)
a1_check.per_cube_note: cal/energy_blocks.py on the A1 session (servo current sum, arm INA260 NaN). Within ~5 % of the grid (20/1.5: 20.8 J, 15/1.5: 20.2 J); grid rows kept for the optimizer.
a1_check.cube_set_correction: operator 2026-10-26: cubes were orange + white; vision looked for white only (4/24 seen). meta "white 40mm" is wrong.
